title: Casebook — projects from my sources
rules: Every fact comes from the linked article or the project's own website; nothing is added from memory.
Fields the sources don't give are marked 'Not stated' / 'Not named', or null for coordinates.
Projects are grouped by their main theme. 'themes' lists every theme that applies.
No project appears twice. Anything already in the Casebook goes under 'alreadyInCasebook' instead of being listed again.
Photos from Wikimedia Commons are allowed, with credit.
Community means schools, clinics, community centres and neighbourhood-led or upgrading projects. Public architecture & space means civic and cultural buildings, parks, streets and squares.
Pages on a source that describe parts of one project are grouped as one entry.

linkStatusKey.working: Loads and is free to read
